series.label: U.S. Field Production of Crude Oil, Annual · Thousand Barrels per Day · annual history
series.definition: U.S. Energy Information Administration native series PET.MCRFPUS2.A. U.S. Field Production of Crude Oil, Annual. Quantities are not converted, annualized or joined to other editions.
limitations: Frozen publisher source bytes acquired 1 November 2026; this is not a live feed or a claim that all values are direct measurements.
Source units, quantities, source year labels and unavailable values are retained. No local interpolation, carry-forward, averaging, zero filling or numerical unit conversion is performed.

Countries and territories follow the publisher labels and country definitions. Historical borders or reporting populations may change even when a country name does not. Modern map geometry does not establish equivalent historical territory.
Production, consumption, trade, installed capacity and energy-accounting measures are separate. Native energy-content and physical units must not be added as independent quantities.
The earliest source years are historical estimates and geographic coverage can change. The fixed modern polygon does not represent historical U.S. borders.
Annual volume and annual-average daily production have different units. They must not be summed as distinct output.
series.reporting_period: Native annual reporting years; quantity versus annual daily average remains a separate source series
series.license: U.S. government public domain; acknowledgment requested
series.description: U.S. Energy Information Administration native series PET.MCRFPUS2.A. U.S. Field Production of Crude Oil, Annual. Quantities are not converted, annualized or joined to other editions.

dataset.description: Two distinct native source measures: annual thousand barrels and annual-average thousand barrels per day. They are parallel views of production, not separate output to sum.
